question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.**

Tangle
solution:
The correct answer is: **Simple**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tangle **means to twist or interweave in a confused mass. (उलझन)

 
 
• **Example**: *A tangle of wires is all that remains of the computer and phone systems.*
 
 
 
• **Simple **means easy to understand or do. (आसान)
 
 
• **Example**: *The rules of the game are quite simple. *
 
 
 
• Antonym means a word that means the opposite of another word.
 
• Therefore, Simple is the most appropriate antonym for Tangle.

Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Jam **means a crowded or blocked situation. (अवरोध)
 
• **Labyrinth **means a complex maze or system of paths. (भूलभुलैया)
 
• **Coil **means to wind or twist something into a series of rings or spirals. (कुंडल)
